intro.calendar: calendar: an app to manage daily events on calendar.
intro.excel: excel: an app to manipulate excel files, including reading, writing, etc.
intro.ocr: ocr: an app to recognize text from images.
intro.pdf: pdf: an app to manipulate pdf files, including format conversion and file reading.
intro.shell: shell: an app to run shell commands in the system.
intro.word: word: an app to manipulate word files, including reading, writing, converting, etc.
intro.email: email: an app to manage emails, such as sending and reading emails.
intro.llm: llm: an app to interact with the large language model to answer questions, generate text, etc.

calendar.create_event: create a new event to a user's calendar where the time format is '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S':{'app': 'calendar', 'action': 'create_event', 'user': [USER_NAME], 'summary': [EVENT_SUMMARY], 'time_start': [EVENT_START_TIME], 'time_end': [EVENT_END_TIME]}
calendar.delete_event: delete an event from a user's calendar given the event summary:{'app': 'calendar', 'action': 'delete_event', 'user': [USER_NAME], 'summary': [EVENT_SUMMARY]}
calendar.list_events: list all events from a user's calendar: {'app': 'calendar', 'action': 'list_events', 'username': [USER_NAME]}

excel.read_file: read the excel file to see the existing contents: {'app': 'excel', 'action': 'read_file', 'file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_EXCEL_FILE]
excel.set_cell: write text to a cell in the excel file (index starts from 1): {'app': 'excel', 'action': 'set_cell', 'file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_EXCEL_FILE], 'row_idx': [THE_ROW_INDEX], 'column_idx': [THE_COLUMN_INDEX], 'text': [THE_TEXT_TO_WRITE]}
excel.delete_cell: delete text in a cell of the excel file (index starts from 1, delete means set empty): {'app': 'excel', 'action': 'delete_cell', 'file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_EXCEL_FILE], 'row_idx': [THE_ROW_INDEX], 'column_idx': [THE_COLUMN_INDEX]
excel.convert_to_pdf: convert an excel document to a pdf: {'app': 'excel', 'action': 'convert_to_pdf', 'excel_file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_EXCEL_FILE], 'pdf_file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_PDF_FILE]}

ocr.recognize_file: recognize the text from an image file: {'app': 'ocr', 'action': 'recognize_file', 'file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_IMAGE_FILE]}

pdf.convert_to_image: convert a pdf file to an image file: {'app': 'pdf', 'action': 'convert_to_image', 'pdf_file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_PDF_FILE], 'image_file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_IMAGE_FILE]}
pdf.convert_to_word: convert a pdf file to a word file: {'app': 'pdf', 'action': 'convert_to_word', 'pdf_file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_PDF_FILE], 'word_file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_WORD_FILE]}

email.send_email: Send an email to a recipient: {'app': 'email', 'action': 'send_email', 'sender': [SENDER], 'recipient': [RECIPIENT], 'subject': [SUBJECT], 'content': [CONTENT]}
email.list_emails: List emails for a given username: {'app': 'email', 'action': 'list_emails', 'username': [USER_NAME]}
email.read_email: Read a user's email by the given Email ID: {'app': 'email', 'action': 'read_email', 'username': [USERNAME], 'email_id': [EMAIL_ID]}

word.convert_to_pdf: convert a word document to a pdf: {'app': 'word', 'action': 'convert_to_pdf', 'word_file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_WORD_FILE], 'pdf_file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_PDF_FILE]}
word.read_file: read the content of the word file: {'app': 'word', 'action': 'read_file', 'file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_WORD_FILE]
word.write_to_file: write text to a word file: {'app': 'word', 'action': 'write_to_file', 'file_path': [THE_PATH_TO_THE_WORD_FILE], 'contents': [THE_CONTENTS_YOU_WISH_TO_WRITE]}

llm.complete_text: Query an LLM model for an answer to a given prompt: {'app': 'llm', 'action': 'complete_text', 'prompt': [PROMPT]}
